title: Social Bridge
description: Advanced social features: friends system, public servers, WebRTC P2P connections with privacy protection.
body:
# SocialBridge - Advanced Social Features for Minecraft

SocialBridge adds advanced social features to Minecraft for free. For the mod to work, 2 players must have the mod installed It's work after mojang's ban P2P connections

## Features

### Friends System
- Add friends by username
- Accept/reject friend requests

### Public Servers
- Create public servers with one click
- Join servers without knowing IP address
- Automatic UPnP port forwarding
- WebRTC P2P connections
- Host approval system

## Remote Connections & Data Collection

This mod connects to the following external services:

**Firebase**
- Firebase Realtime Database (firebaseio.com) — stores friend lists, friend requests, presence status, and public server listings
- Firebase Authentication (identitytoolkit.googleapis.com) — Google Sign-In for account creation

**WebRTC / STUN / TURN**
- stun.l.google.com:19302 — STUN server for P2P connection negotiation
- stun.cloudflare.com:3478 — STUN server
- openrelay.metered.ca:443 — TURN relay server

**Data stored:**
- SocialBridge username
- Minecraft username and UUID
- Online/offline presence status
- Friend list
No passwords or payment data are collected. All data can be deleted by contacting the developer
